title: The web of Markdown, part 3
content:
Previous posts on this topic: Oct 6 and Oct 8.

What's new? I've got a browser running, and have been using it for a few weeks. We're not releasing it today because first I want people to think about the format we're using to represent a story, and get feedback, and see if other people can build on the same basis.

Three things to look at today.

  • The top level picture.
  • Nine examples.
  • Download the archive.

And if you have questions or comments.

  • Use the Issues section in the repo.
